content.short: SPACE ID provides a one-stop Web3 domain and identity platform.
content.description: SPACE ID 2.0 provides a unified Web3 domain and identity platform that lets users discover, register, trade, and manage Web3 domains across multiple blockchains. It consolidates the fragmented experience of domain ownership, removing the need to use separate marketplaces for different chains. The platform also offers a Web3 name SDK and API for developers, enabling integration across blockchains, and delivers a multi-chain name service designed to help anyone build and establish a Web3 identity with ease.
